quotes.text: The balance of your wallet(s) will be backed by an equivalent amount of money which LemFi holds in its safeguarded accounts.
Please note that the money in your NGN account is held by your NGN account provider in Nigeria, not by LemFi, and is not safeguarded under UK requirements.

quotes.text: Safeguarding your money means that in the unlikely event that LemFi gets into financial difficulties, the money which LemFi safeguards on your behalf will be protected from the claims of LemFi's creditors and should be returned to you in full.
